name: hmi_set_tag_dynamization
description: Set tag dynamization on a screen item property using numeric ranges or Boolean Singlebit mapping. An existing Singlebit mapping is updated in place. Switching an existing mapping table with entries to another condition type, or replacing a non-tag dynamization, fails: call hmi_delete_dynamization first. 'None' only sets the tag and leaves an existing mapping table unchanged. All changes run in one transaction and are rolled back on failure.

ranges.description: For Range, list numeric from/to bounds. For Singlebit, provide exactly two entries with matching bounds 0/0 and 1/1; their values map the off/on states.
